_README: Ability-material targets, ordered by the unit-priority ladder in scripts/invest_plan.py. DERIVED, NOT GUESSED: generated 2026-08-08 by intersecting (a) HotUtils gamedata/units, which lists every unit's omicron abilities with a mode id, (b) the per-unit applied-omicron counters in account/data/all, and (c) the live board in data/board_result.json. An entry appears only when the unit sits on a board whose MODE matches the omicron's mode and the omicron is NOT yet applied. Mode ids were derived empirically, not from documentation: 7=Territory Battle, 8=Territory War, 9=Grand Arena, 11=Conquest (see memory/notes.md 2026-08-08). Result: all 17 open targets are TERRITORY WAR. There are ZERO unapplied Grand Arena omicrons on GAC board units, so that side is already maxed - which is itself the finding. NOTE omicrons do NOT fire in Squad Arena, so nothing here helps the arena squad.
